0.0: The small-scale attacks, Specters invading without leadership... I would almost say that our enemies are attempting to stall for time. Our own soldiers are quite tired, but this may be our opportunity to drive out the enemy for good.
0.1: Our first step is to chase out the remnants of the Specter army. They may even lead us to the main force, though all the attacks on the rear of the central regions would indicate pretty strongly where they're hiding.

yes.0: It's highly probable that the main army is hiding just right of the central region, penetrating through the forest that cuts across the valley. That would be a good place to start looking.

no.0: Talk to me again when your battle preparations are complete.

1.0: Your feats have gotten us this far, Kaiser. We should be able to enter the castle soon.
1.1: Please speak with #b#p3000000##k. He will be taking #b#p3001001##k's place as commander.
